answer: Smallest check that still costs more to fake than to run: hash the task input, have two peers re-execute it, compare outputs. The median of the two scores decides, so one inflated grade is diluted to zero. Payment vests six epochs against continued work, and a stalled identity keeps nothing. One container per claim. A farm replicating juniper-growing advice or appraising marble lots pays that same container bill per fake, then waits six epochs on stake before a trellis of seats earns anything.
